Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €346.17 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
Please note:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your updated volume forecast and welcome the proposed 14-day payment terms.
Adopting the CU-NOTATION index clause allows us to manage material volatility effectively, enabling a revised base price of €346.17.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €345.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
For your information:
We appreciate your revised offer and your commitment to the binding volume of 6,110 pieces.
In response to your movement, we are prepared to adjust our price to €345.15 per unit under the 14-day payment terms and the CU-NOTATION index clause.
This represents a fair compromise that reflects the value of our cooperation while managing material volatility.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
